name: The Anomaly Manor
storyline:
There's a mansion shrouded in a dark legend: anyone who enters vanishes forever. It's said that years ago, one night, something terrible happened within its walls.

Equipped with your spectral camera, you decide to venture inside to investigate. Locate and photograph the anomalies to escape before the wandering souls catch you.

If you're skilled, you can uncover the story and discover the truth.
